text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. Black shiny ruched off-shoulder mid-calf dress, sheer black tights and black lace heels.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Arrange the same black dress, EMPTY flattened sheer black tights, and EMPTY black lace shoes as a neat FLAT LAY on white. Remove all legs, skin, toes and body volume inside tights or shoes. Preserve fabric design and all garment pieces. Pure white seamless background, soft studio light, realistic materials, full uncropped portrait 2:3 1024x1536. No person, skin, anatomical body parts, visible mannequin, stand, labels, text, insets, collage or watermark. Change only the listed issues; preserve all remaining image details.
